stories.deterministic: User Story: As a memory owner, Given the same fact twice, When embeddings are generated, Then every vector component is identical
stories.normalized: User Story: As a storage engine, Given an authored fact, When its embedding is generated, Then the configured dimension and unit norm are preserved
stories.naturalQuestion: User Story: As a character, Given a stored fact, When the same subject is asked as a natural question, Then recall similarity clears the protocol threshold
stories.unrelatedQuestion: User Story: As a character, Given a stored fact, When an unrelated subject is asked, Then recall similarity remains below the protocol threshold

fact: The signal changed from green to amber.
naturalQuestion: What color did the signal change to? Answer briefly.
unrelatedQuestion: A round marker was placed on the table.
